RD7ugxaBHSQ shifts from calf circulation to modified push-ups. 1bb5M4E1oQs uses a 7-day no-sugar/no-carb thumbnail for a potassium/blood-pressure video.
diagnosis.visual_and_transcript_evidence: Frame luminance is 0 from 50 s to 80 s in UeGxF8-hb2s; sampled 7MXBh2hjfto anchors show only cancer-myth content; sampled RD7ugxaBHSQ anchors show modified push-ups; retained 1bb5M4E1oQs thumbnail was re-inspected at full size.
diagnosis.comparative_evidence: Uq3T8YZgyTw was the closest word-density candidate for another tail defect, but sampled frames at 47.1 and 49.8 s show a white engagement card through its 50.82 s end, not black.
diagnosis.historical_context: Affected uploads span February to September 2026
diagnosis.counterexample: Not every low-word-density or static-ending video has a black tail; Uq3T8YZgyTw explicitly refutes that generalization. RD7ugxaBHSQ's largest early loss precedes its title-scope shift, so the mismatch cannot explain the opening drop.
diagnosis.alternative_explanations: Tiny samples, later title changes and unknown traffic sources limit performance attribution
diagnosis.confidence: HIGH that the listed defects/mismatches exist; MEDIUM that the black tail depresses APV; LOW for distribution effects
diagnosis.practical_experiment: Re-export or trim UeGxF8-hb2s; align title, thumbnail and delivered content for 7MXBh2hjfto, RD7ugxaBHSQ and 1bb5M4E1oQs; verify every final render before upload.

remaining_private_requirements: Per-video traffic-source, Search and Suggested drill-downs

youtube_definitions.new_viewers: Watched the channel for the first time in the period (includes people with cleared history or private browsing, or who have not watched in over a year).
youtube_definitions.casual_viewers: Watched the channel at least once per month for 1 to 5 months in the past year.
youtube_definitions.regular_viewers: Watched the channel at least once per month for more than 6 months in the past year.
youtube_definitions.returning_viewers: Umbrella term for casual plus regular viewers; the retention report's new-vs-returning split is a separate segmentation of retention curves, not a viewer count.
youtube_definitions.monthly_audience: Unique viewers in the last 28 days.

claim_audit.previous_claim: The channel is not yet building a returning audience; zero regular viewers make returning viewers the binding constraint.
claim_audit.original_evidence: studio-audience-size-growth-last-28-days.zip: 2026-09-26 row 495 new, 10 casual, 0 regular; monthly audience 505.
claim_audit.sample_size: 505 monthly viewers; casual 3-10 across the 28 rows
claim_audit.confounders: Channel first published 2026-02-03; lifetime Totals.csv shows only 8 views in April 2026, so almost no viewer can have watched in more than 6 of the past 12 months. Views jumped on 2026-09-09 when the coffee Shorts began (new viewers 339 to 458 in one day).
claim_audit.counterexamples: Casual (returning) viewers rose from 3 to 10 during the window while new viewers also rose.
claim_audit.evidence_strength: Regular = 0 is structurally expected for this channel age and gap; it is not evidence of a retention failure. Casual share is 2.0% of monthly audience, which is low but measured over one 28-day window only.
claim_audit.corrected_interpretation: Audience development is UNPROVEN, not demonstrated as the binding constraint. The measurable fact is that about 98% of the latest 28-day audience was new. Whether the channel converts viewers into casual/regular viewers can only be judged after several further 28-day exports.

claim_audit.previous_claim: Retention exports show returning viewers holding better (FDLU7tX7qNM 46.15% vs 17.78% new at 30 s).
claim_audit.original_evidence: audience-retention-by-video exports with a new-vs-returning split (11 videos).
claim_audit.sample_size: 11 videos; returning cohort counts are not disclosed and are very small
claim_audit.confounders: Returning cohorts can be a handful of viewers; Studio discloses curve shape only.
claim_audit.counterexamples: Returning viewers retained LESS than new viewers at the 30 s position in 8 of 11 videos (e.g. 8JdBlF-ragM 20.0 vs 62.75, 78JR_U-6HfQ 40.0 vs 60.87, qC8BKb8Fh5Q 18.18 vs 37.5); higher only in FDLU7tX7qNM and xI-KdZ96xcI; equal in BCNWQ3uuSuE.
claim_audit.evidence_strength: The earlier claim was a single-example selection.
claim_audit.corrected_interpretation: No consistent returning-viewer retention advantage exists in the available splits; the cohort is too small to interpret.

claim_audit.original_evidence: studio-advanced-geography-lifetime.zip: 8,366 total views; 12 disclosed countries carry 2,746 views.
claim_audit.sample_size: 2,746 of 8,366 views (32.8%) have a disclosed country
claim_audit.confounders: Studio withholds small-country rows; undisclosed views may be concentrated or spread across many countries.
claim_audit.counterexamples: US 327 and GB 305 views are 11.9% and 11.1% of the disclosed set.
claim_audit.evidence_strength: Within the disclosed third: IN 48.7%, PK 15.0%, LK/NP/BD 4.2% (South Asia ~68%). Nothing can be said about the other 67%.
claim_audit.corrected_interpretation: South Asia is the largest DISCLOSED segment. The overall audience composition is unknown; do not extrapolate. The previous percentages (IN 16.0%) were shares of total views, correct arithmetic but presented without the disclosure caveat.

claim_audit.previous_claim: Discovery comes from other creators' health videos and a long search tail.
claim_audit.original_evidence: Traffic-source lifetime table; Search-term and Suggested-source drill-downs (lifetime).
claim_audit.sample_size: Suggested 1,031 views / 19,841 impressions; Search 1,175 views / 11,245 impressions; 114 disclosed search terms carry 170 views; 472 disclosed Suggested source videos
claim_audit.confounders: Drill-downs disclose only top rows; Suggested impressions in the drill-down (19,844) differ from the source table (19,841) by rounding/refresh.
claim_audit.counterexamples: Monthly source mix changed: Suggested led May-July (250/340/220 views) but Search led August (317) and September (340); Shorts feed dominated February-March.
claim_audit.evidence_strength: Facts: Shorts feed is 64% of lifetime views; own-channel videos supplied 70 of 1,031 Suggested views; no search term exceeds 7 views.
claim_audit.corrected_interpretation: Long-form discovery is fragmented across many external source videos and many low-volume search terms; there is no dominant query or source. This says nothing about whether the recommendation system 'prefers' the channel. Search's rising monthly share since August is the only upward source trend visible.

claim_audit.previous_claim: Lowest CTR among videos with >=500 impressions: HzFdyjyEFTY 1.35%, qbwCkH_GqhU 1.65%, EB3_A2b4a6o 1.81%; Shorts cardiology median CTR 1.48%.
claim_audit.confounders: qbwCkH_GqhU is a 50-second Short: Shorts-feed views carry no thumbnail impression, so Shorts CTR describes only non-feed surfaces and is not comparable. HzFdyjyEFTY was 10 days old at export. CTR mixes Search (2.71%) and Suggested (2.9%) surfaces with different eligibility.
claim_audit.counterexamples: EB3_A2b4a6o has the second-highest impressions (3,703) with 1.81% CTR yet 60.0% 30-second retention: low click response did not mean poor content response.
claim_audit.evidence_strength: Long-form CTR range 1.35-4.89% among mature videos is real variation; Shorts CTR comparisons are invalid.
claim_audit.corrected_interpretation: Remove qbwCkH_GqhU and all Shorts CTR medians from packaging conclusions. Treat HzFdyjyEFTY as immature. EB3_A2b4a6o is the clearest mature long-form case where packaging under-performs the content.

claim_audit.previous_claim: Concrete self-test/symptom openings hold more viewers; slow or generic setup coincides with faster decline; fast cutting is not a reliable lever.
claim_audit.sample_size: Long-form videos with 80-367 views; 30 s retention has roughly +/-10 percentage-point 95% uncertainty at 100 viewers
claim_audit.confounders: Topic, traffic source mix, length and video age are uncontrolled.
claim_audit.counterexamples: HzFdyjyEFTY opens on a direct question and holds 66.7% at 30 s but has the lowest CTR; CZ3gAUzdTAg (most views) holds only 43.9% at 30 s.
claim_audit.evidence_strength: Differences above ~20 points (BCNWQ3uuSuE 60.5% vs SBrMW71O69U 38.5%) exceed sampling noise; smaller ones do not. All are associations.
claim_audit.corrected_interpretation: Supported as an association: openings that state the specific question and pay it off within 30-50 s (BCNWQ3uuSuE fasting myth at 0:40-0:50; HzFdyjyEFTY aspirin reveal at 0:32) hold better than openings built from generic framing and self-promotion (SBrMW71O69U channel-handle overlay 0:18-0:24). Cutting frequency is unrelated in this catalog. Caption timecode defects show no consistent retention direction.

priority_review_method.visual: YouTube storyboard level-2 sprite sheets (160x90 per frame for long-form, 45x80 for Shorts) at the frame interval YouTube publishes (1 s for videos under ~100 s, 2 s to 5 s for longer ones), viewed sheet by sheet on 2026-09-28. This is continuous full-length visual progression at storyboard resolution, not full-frame-rate playback.
priority_review_method.speech: Retained uploaded caption track (creator-provided text) read in full. YouTube's auto-generated (ASR) track exists for all 12 videos but could not be retrieved in the signed-out browser (timedtext requests rejected; player exposes only the manual track).
priority_review_method.audio: NOT HEARD. The agent environment has no audio output and no local speech-recognition tool; audible speech quality, music level and mix are therefore not assessed. Automated volume measurements from earlier signal passes are not used as evidence of audible quality.

medical_references.USPSTF_2022_ASPIRIN: US Preventive Services Task Force, Aspirin Use to Prevent Cardiovascular Disease (2022): Grade D against initiating for primary prevention at >=60; Grade C individual decision at 40-59 with >=10% 10-year risk; current users should not discontinue without consulting their clinician.
medical_references.ACC_AHA_2019_PRIMARY: 2019 ACC/AHA Guideline on the Primary Prevention of Cardiovascular Disease: low-dose aspirin should not be administered routinely for primary prevention in adults >70 or with increased bleeding risk; may be considered selectively at 40-70.
medical_references.CAPRIE_1996: CAPRIE (Lancet 1996): clopidogrel versus aspirin in patients with recent stroke, MI or peripheral arterial disease (secondary prevention). It is not a primary-prevention aspirin trial; the relevant primary-prevention trials are ASPREE, ARRIVE and ASCEND (2018).
medical_references.ESC_EAS_2019_LIPIDS: 2019 ESC/EAS Dyslipidaemia Guidelines: LDL-C goals by risk category, <55 mg/dL very high risk (including established ASCVD), <70 high risk, <100 moderate risk, <116 low risk.
medical_references.AHA_ACC_2018_CHOLESTEROL: 2018 AHA/ACC Cholesterol Guideline: non-fasting lipid profile acceptable for initial risk assessment; fasting repeat if triglycerides >=400 mg/dL.
medical_references.FDA_SEMAGLUTIDE_LABEL: Ozempic/Wegovy US prescribing information: boxed warning for thyroid C-cell tumours in rodents (human relevance not determined); contraindicated with personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or MEN 2.
medical_references.AHA_DIET_2021: 2021 AHA Dietary Guidance to Improve Cardiovascular Health: dietary patterns (fish, vegetables, nuts, olive oil) lower risk; no individual food reverses established atherosclerosis.
medical_references.CDC_STEADI_CHAIR_STAND: CDC STEADI 30-Second Chair Stand: below-average scores are age- and sex-specific (e.g. <12 for men and <11 for women aged 60-64).

medical_claim_reviews.claim: 'Avoid taking aspirin for the sake of preventing yourself from developing any heart condition' addressed to viewers over 60 already taking it daily.
medical_claim_reviews.analysis: Direction (no routine primary-prevention aspirin at >=60) matches guidelines, but the video addresses current users and never advises discussing it with a clinician first. USPSTF explicitly says current users should not discontinue without consulting their clinician; some viewers may have undiagnosed indications (stents, AF history, PAD).
medical_claim_reviews.alternative_wording: If you are over 60 and take daily aspirin but have never had a heart attack, stroke or stent, ask your doctor whether you still need it. Do not stop it on your own.

medical_claim_reviews.claim: 'We have data from CAPRIE clinical trial ... harms supersede the benefits' for primary prevention.
medical_claim_reviews.analysis: CAPRIE compared clopidogrel and aspirin in secondary prevention; it does not support the primary-prevention statement.
medical_claim_reviews.alternative_wording: Large trials such as ASPREE, ARRIVE and ASCEND found that for people without heart disease, bleeding risk largely offsets the small benefit.

medical_claim_reviews.claim: 'Aspirin is now regarded to be contraindicated ... for primary prevention.'
medical_claim_reviews.analysis: Guidelines say 'not recommended routinely' or 'individual decision' at 40-59; 'contraindicated' is a stronger clinical term.
medical_claim_reviews.alternative_wording: Aspirin is no longer routinely recommended for people without heart disease.

medical_claim_reviews.claim: Semaglutide causes 'new adverse effects', 'Ozempic vagina' and loss of libido, via genital fat loss making tissue 'saggy, petulous and dry because of dehydration'.
medical_claim_reviews.analysis: Neither term is a recognised adverse effect in the prescribing information or major trials; the mechanism is presented as fact without cited evidence. Rapid weight loss and hydration advice is reasonable general guidance.
medical_claim_reviews.alternative_wording: Some people online describe changes they call 'Ozempic vagina'. It is not a recognised side effect and research is limited; if you notice changes in sexual health or dryness while losing weight, discuss them with your doctor.

medical_claim_reviews.claim: Title promises an Ozempic versus appetite-suppressant comparison.
medical_claim_reviews.analysis: Content only addresses a cancer myth.
medical_claim_reviews.alternative_wording: Does Ozempic Cause Cancer? What the Warning Label Actually Means

medical_claim_reviews.claim: 'Ozempic has not been caused for any kind of cancer ... has not shown in any clinical trial for causing any kind of cancer'; warning described as family history only.
medical_claim_reviews.analysis: Trials have not shown a clear human cancer increase, but the boxed warning rests on rodent thyroid C-cell tumours with human relevance undetermined, and the contraindication covers personal as well as family history.
medical_claim_reviews.alternative_wording: Trials so far have not shown a clear rise in cancer in people. The label warns about thyroid tumours seen in animals, so it is not used if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid cancer or MEN 2.

medical_claim_reviews.claim: Title: '5 Foods That Reverse Artery Damage'.
medical_claim_reviews.analysis: The script says no single food can fix arteries; no food reverses established plaque.
medical_claim_reviews.alternative_wording: 5 Foods That Support Healthy Arteries (Doctor Explains)

medical_claim_reviews.claim: LDL <100 ideal; <70 with diabetes or high blood pressure; <55 with established coronary or cerebrovascular disease.
medical_claim_reviews.analysis: Matches ESC/EAS goals, but ESC assigns targets by total risk category rather than diabetes/hypertension alone.
medical_claim_reviews.alternative_wording: Your LDL target depends on your overall risk; your doctor sets it, often below 70 or 55 if you have diabetes or heart disease.

medical_claim_reviews.claim: The first lipid profile can be non-fasting; only triglycerides are fasting-dependent.
Five foods 'may help support healthy arteries'; no food removes plaque overnight.
Dawn phenomenon, sleep and medication timing can raise fasting glucose; do not stop medicines.
medical_claim_reviews.analysis: Accurate and safety-conscious; in-video 'seven reasons' promise only partly delivered (five factors).
medical_claim_reviews.alternative_wording: Five reasons your morning blood sugar may be higher (or add the missing two).

medical_claim_reviews.claim: Palpitations, anxiety, sleep problems after coffee warrant contacting a healthcare provider.
No single passing score for the 30-second chair stand; the number reflects strength and endurance.
medical_claim_reviews.analysis: True that norms vary, but CDC publishes age/sex thresholds the title question ('Is 12 good?') could answer.
medical_claim_reviews.alternative_wording: For ages 60-64, fewer than 12 stands (men) or 11 (women) is below average; thresholds fall with age.

medical_claim_reviews.claim: Calf pain on walking (claudication), cold feet and foot swelling can signal circulation problems.
medical_claim_reviews.analysis: Presented as signals to check, not diagnoses.

medical_claim_reviews.claim: Persistent ankle swelling can be linked to heart function and should be checked.

root_cause_matrix.observation: Two misleading titles, one unsafe instruction, one speculative medical claim, one 39 s black tail, one editor watermark, caption defects on 10 tracks.

not_supported_by_data: Zero regular viewers proves a returning-audience failure (structurally expected for channel age).
Returning viewers retain better (8 of 11 splits show the opposite).
The audience is predominantly South Asian (only 32.8% of views have a disclosed country).
Shorts CTR differences reflect packaging quality (Shorts-feed views carry no impressions).
Faster cutting improves retention (NznebmgFwXI 0.8 cuts/min held better than KPYHy7MDmLM 16.9).
Caption timecode defects reduce retention (no consistent direction).
Cardiology topics under-perform broader health topics (within 0.6 CTR points, direction reverses by format).
The recommendation system prefers or penalises the channel (no data can show this).
Posting Shorts and long-form on one channel harms growth (DS-000018 creator claim; cross-format data not exported).

experiments.name: Long-form title/thumbnail Test & Compare
experiments.purpose: Test whether a specific question/answer package lifts click response on videos whose content already holds viewers.
experiments.evidence_basis: EB3_A2b4a6o CTR 1.81% vs 60.0% 30 s retention; HzFdyjyEFTY CTR 1.35% vs 66.67%.
experiments.window: Days 1-30; YouTube Studio Test & Compare runs up to 2 weeks per test
experiments.metrics: Test & Compare watch-time share (YouTube's winner criterion); secondary impressions CTR from the same period
experiments.interpretation: Count a lift only if Studio declares a winner; 'inconclusive' is a valid result and means packaging is not the limiting factor for that video. Never compare against lifetime CTR.

experiments.name: Opening structure on new long-form
experiments.purpose: Test early specific payoff: state the question in the first sentence and deliver the first concrete answer by 0:30, with no channel-handle or subscribe overlay before 1:00.
eligible_videos: Next 6 long-form uploads, alternating with 3 in the current style if cadence allows
experiments.evidence_basis: BCNWQ3uuSuE vs SBrMW71O69U; CZ3gAUzdTAg stock insert before the first item.
experiments.window: Days 1-60; evaluate each video at 28 days
experiments.metrics: Retention at 30 s and 60 s (Studio key moments), average percentage viewed; views only as context
experiments.interpretation: Require a difference above ~15 points in 30 s retention between groups before acting; with ~100 viewers per video smaller differences are noise. Report as association unless randomised.

experiments.name: Shorts first-frame specificity
experiments.purpose: Test whether a distinct first frame plus a named symptom or number improves stayed-to-watch.
eligible_videos: Next 8 Shorts: 4 with a distinct visual first frame and named symptom, 4 in the current talking-head style
experiments.evidence_basis: QfRaG71ZA_0 (57.28% stayed) vs 4ByUo2N_C-I (43.7%) from the same footage.
experiments.metrics: Stayed to watch (%) and engaged views; ignore Shorts CTR
experiments.interpretation: Shorts feed cohorts vary; judge on the median of each group of 4, not the single best Short.

experiments.name: Topic cluster/series pilot
experiments.purpose: Test whether a connected 3-part long-form series with explicit end-screen links raises own-channel Suggested views and casual viewers.
eligible_videos: New 3-part series on one topic that already showed interest (lipid tests: BCNWQ3uuSuE; leg/circulation signals: 5oPzZjfNgII, NznebmgFwXI)
experiments.evidence_basis: Own-channel videos supplied only 70 of 1,031 Suggested views; DS-000031 cluster/series framework (creator claim).
experiments.metrics: Own-channel Suggested views per series video (Suggested drill-down), end-screen click rate, 28-day casual viewers
experiments.interpretation: Useful evidence = own-channel Suggested share of series videos above the channel's 6.8% lifetime baseline; casual viewer count is secondary because it is channel-wide.

experiments.name: Medical-accuracy guardrail (process, not growth test)
experiments.purpose: Every new script checked against a named guideline before recording; titles may not claim reversal/cure.
experiments.evidence_basis: Five significant claim issues in the priority set.
experiments.metrics: Count of claims with named source; zero unsupported treatment claims
